name: GMT7 helper public trading functions
summary: The unverified GMT7 helper holds GMT7 balances and router approvals and exposes its buy/sell functions publicly, so the attacker forced it to buy GMT7 and then repeatedly sell the helper's GMT7 to the GMT7/USDT pair while routing the USDT output to itself.
